newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Germantown, Tenn.

text.p: SUMMARY OF NOTICE OF SALE
City of Germantown
Tennessee
General Obligation and Refunding Bonds, Series 1996
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that sealed bids will be received by the Finance Director of the City of Germantown, Tennessee at the Board of Mayor and Aldermen Chambers in the
Germantown City Hall, 1930 South Germantown Road,
Germantown, Tennessee, 38138, until 11:00 a.m. (Central Standard Time), on
Tuesday, December 17, 1996,

for the purchase of $9,680,000 General Obligation and Refunding Bonds, Series 1996 of the City of Germantown, Tennessee (the City''), at which time and place the sealed bids will be opened and announced.

The Bonds shall be issued in registered form, of the denominations, bear interest payable at such times, mature in the years and in the amounts and bear such other details as set forth in the Official Notice of Sale herein referred to.

The Bonds are general obligations of the City. The full faith and credit and unlimited taxing power of the City are being pledged to the payment of the principal of the Bonds and the interest thereon.

The Board of Mayor and Aldermen will meet at its Council Chambers in the City Hall, at 7:30 p.m. on the sale date for the purpose of considering the bids. All bids must comply with the terms and conditions of the Official Notice of Sale herein referred to.

As a condition to the purchaser's obligation to accept delivery of and pay for the Bonds, the City will furnish upon the delivery of the Bonds the opinion as to the validity of the Bonds of Baker, Donelson, Bearman &

Caldwell, of Memphis, Tennessee, Bond Counsel to the City, which opinion will be printed upon the Bonds, together with the usual closing documents, including a certificate that no litigation is pending affecting the validity of the Bonds.

Bidders must use the bid form or forms which, together with financial information for bidders, the Official Notice of Sale and the proposed Official Statement containing pertinent information relating to the issuance, sale and security of the Bonds, may be obtained from John Dluhos, Finance Director, Germantown City Hall, 1930 South

Germantown Road, Germantown, Tennessee 38138, (901) 757- 7280, or from Marlin Mosby or Andre walker, Public Financial Management, 530 Oak Court Drive, Memphis, Tennessee, 38117, Telephone (901) 682-8356.
Dated: December 12, 1996.
CITY OF GERMANTOWN, TENNESSEE
By /s/JOHN DLUHOS
Finance Director
(From The Bond Buyer)
